Serving Onion Soup

OVERCOOKED GAME MECHANICS (MDP Knowledge) - ONION SOUP

State Variables:
- soup_cooking - Is soup actively cooking (ticker >= 1)
- soup_ready - Is soup ready to serve
- soup_served - Is soup delivered to serving station
- soup_staged - Is soup staged/placed somewhere accessible
- dish_staged - Is dish staged/placed somewhere accessible
- dish_hand - Who is holding the dish {none, agent, partner}
- soup_hand - Who is holding the soup {none, agent, partner}
- onion_hand - Who is holding the onion {none, agent, partner}
- onion_staged - Is onion staged/placed somewhere accessible
- onion_at_chopping - Is onion at chopping station
- onion_chopped - Is the onion chopped (flag set when placed at chopping station)
- onion_in_pot - Is onion placed in cooking pot (chopped)
- tomato_hand - Who is holding the tomato {none, agent, partner}
- tomato_staged - Is tomato staged/placed somewhere accessible
- tomato_at_chopping - Is tomato at chopping station
- tomato_chopped - Is the tomato chopped (flag set when placed at chopping station)
- tomato_in_pot - Is tomato placed in cooking pot (chopped)

PRIMARY ACTION SEQUENCE FOR THIS RECIPE:
1. Human Grab Onion
2. Place onion in pot
3. Turn stove on
4. Wait for ingredients to cook
5. Human Grab dish
6. Pour soup
7. Human Stage Soup

TRANSITION RULES (Primary Actions Only):
- Human Grab Onion: onion_staged=true → onion_hand=partner, onion_staged=false
- Place onion in pot: onion_hand=partner → onion_in_pot=true, onion_hand=none
- Turn stove on: onion_in_pot=true → soup_cooking=true
- Wait for ingredients to cook: soup_cooking=true → soup_ready=true (automatic)
- Human Grab dish: dish_staged=true → dish_hand=partner, dish_staged=false
- Pour soup: soup_ready=true, dish_hand=partner → soup_hand=partner, onion_in_pot=false, dish_hand=none
- Human Stage Soup: soup_hand=partner → soup_staged=true, soup_hand=none
- Reset: soup_served=true → onion_in_pot=false
- NOOP: No state change, waiting for conditions to be met or other actions to complete
